Meta.description: Brigite's Studio — personal training with Sara Brigites. Personalised coaching, real support and lasting results.

Hero.intro: Designed for beginners, fitness enthusiasts, performers and athletes alike, my coaching supports you in building strength, improving mobility and developing confidence in your body at every stage of your journey.

Services.intro: Strength, conditioning and personalised training designed around your goals and lifestyle, helping you become healthier, stronger, and more confident in your body and yourself.

featured.title: Personal Training
featured.description: Build strength, improve your health and develop confidence in your body through personalised training tailored to your goals, lifestyle and experience.

aerial.title: Aerial & Performance
aerial.description: Coaching for aerial artists and adventurous athletes looking to develop strength, mobility, technique and confidence.

mobility.title: Mobility & Flexibility
mobility.description: Develop flexibility, mobility and body control while improving the way you move, train and feel every day.

handbalancing.title: Handbalancing
handbalancing.description: Discover the art of balancing through a progressive approach focused on strength, awareness and body control. Whether you're a beginner or experienced, sessions are tailored to your level and goals.

performances.title: Performances
performances.description: Bring something extraordinary to your event with bespoke aerial and hand balancing performances designed to captivate and inspire.

About.heading: Hi, I'm Sara.
About.p1: I'm a former athlete and professional acrobat artist with a background in elite-level movement, strength, and body control, performing internationally across Europe, Asia, and the Americas.
About.p2: Alongside my performance career, I've worked as a coach and studied at the University of Kent in London, UK. I am also a YMCA Certified Personal Trainer, combining practical coaching experience with a strong foundation in exercise science.
About.p3: I specialise in personalised training designed to build strength, improve fitness, enhance mobility, and increase confidence. My approach focuses on sustainable results that fit your lifestyle and goals.

Work.title: Sara's work
Work.intro: Aerial, hand balancing and performance — moments captured on stages around the world.
